column7: When a builder's READY lands: name the QA tier in the brief (full: security, data destruction, deploys, human handovers; code-only: tests, docs, config, gated follow-ups; none: hygiene). After 2 NO GO on a class: ship closed, ticket rest; round 3 needs Kam.

When assigning work to a local model: only single file-in/file-out tasks a checker script verifies afterwards; never a ruling, a brief, a QA gate or coordination; it holds no board identity, a seat posts its output. (Model and hours: now Ornith's.)
